About us

News that leaves you with a clearer understanding.

State News Digest is a general news website offering an approachable way to explore important developments and the questions they raise. Our focus is on making information useful — bringing the central facts, relevant background, and wider significance of a story together.

Whether a development concerns a single state, the entire country, or communities overseas, we look for the details that help explain its place in a larger conversation.

The subjects that bring us together

Public life is shaped by many forces at once. Our scope follows those connections — across states, the country, and the world.

Our priorities

Our editorial priorities

The value of a news article depends on how carefully it handles information. Our approach centers on four priorities.

01SubstanceInclude the facts and background readers need to understand the subject.
02PrecisionUse language that reflects the evidence and acknowledges unresolved questions.
03AccessibilityExplain ideas plainly without oversimplifying important details.
04TransparencyIdentify sources and clearly separate reporting, opinion, and sponsored content.
